title: How to Evaluate Explainability? – A Case for Three Criteria
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on proposing and motivating three quality criteria (comprehensibility, fidelity, and assessability) for evaluating the explanatory information provided by AI systems.

measurement_description: The paper does not present a benchmark and does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It is a vision paper proposing three quality criteria for evaluating AI explainability: comprehensibility, fidelity, and assessability.
